Power Stations
Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the testing procedure I1, which must be performed every 6 
months as indicated by M6 in the above title block.
The first draft 
 initiated by eng. Hesham El Sayed Mohamed El Assy, tested by eng. Mohamed Gad 
 El Rab Hawad at 24 March 2003, 
 reviewed by EDEPCo. quality control eng. Abdel Momem El-Emam, accepted by general 
 director eng. Farouk Awad Aly, and approved by eng. Mostafa Alam Head Sector of 
 Talkha power plant.
ZAT-D is system for 
regulation and control of technological processes. It is determined especially 
for use in energetic; it could be used even in other industrial branches. 
Process control is divided into several decentralized parts of system, 
interconnected through communication network. Entire system could be 
hierarchically divided into three basic parts:
 - Visualization system
 - Control system
 - Modular station, contingently other peripherals
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be 
issued and the qualified maintenance staff should be carry the Suitable safety 
category,
